notes.title: Controller + HOTAS support
notes.content:
I will be adding controller and HOTAS support before release (since I feel it will be the most common question anyway).

So I have a few more keys for people to try out the game before release. Looking for people with either of those. PM me on [url=discord.gg/TM9wgxW]discord.gg/TM9wgxW[/url]  if you have an xbox controller (or any generic controller) or a HOTAS controller and you would like to try the game out.

notes.title: Trench Run New Direction
notes.content:
Hi,
so based on the feedback about the gameplay looking boring and slow, I have made significant progress in completely redesigning what the game will be. Instead of a slow relaxing endless runner it will be a fast paced space combat shooter. I will try to post a video of what it will look like as soon as possible. I have just released Survival Simulator so it will take a few days, but I think those who found the flight speed to be too slow, will like the new version a lot more.
